note: Invented records for the kind's read(): the usual one, the longest, and one with its voice missing. No real places, people or recordings.

records.title: The old pump house
records.text: This little house once held the pump for the whole lane. Every morning a keeper turned the big wheel, and water climbed from a deep spring into the trough outside.
